rationale: The customer supplied the key evidence (free-spinning impeller, snapped fin, clear hoses, coil about 170 ohms), and the assistant ignored most of it. It re-asked about the hose after the customer had already said it was disconnected, then wrongly declined an 'unsafe request' the customer never made. The final reply did point to the drain pump, but it was vague, never named the broken impeller, never mentioned the warranty and sent a willing DIYer to an engineer without good reason. It was cautious but not misleading, and it gave no part guidance.
